name: GET /api/leadflow/opportunities/:id/offer-staleness - did the terms move
description:
Compares the offer version a buyer was quoted against the version that is active now.

STALE MEANS THE TERMS MOVED UNDER AN OPEN QUOTE. The buyer is holding a link to something that is no longer what we sell, and the first anybody usually knows is when they try to pay — at which point the conversation is about our mistake rather than their decision. must_requote is true only while the checkout is still open, because a paid one is already settled at the version it was paid against.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: No checkout has been sent for that opportunity, so there is no quoted version to compare
errorCases.when: no checkout session exists for the opportunity.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
